decision.observation: Clicking the seal icon did not visibly change anything; the visa rectangle on the passport remains empty. The toolbar icons may need to be dragged onto the document rather than clicked.
decision.hypothesis: Dragging the seal/stamp icon onto the passport's ENTRY VISA rectangle applies a stamp there.
decision.memory: Bottom toolbar icons don't respond to simple clicks; dragging them into the desk area is the likely mechanic.
